## Who is Sparsh Sharma?

Sparsh Sharma is a 17-year-old self-taught full-stack developer currently based in Bangalore, India. His hometown is Dhampur, a town in West Uttar Pradesh near the Delhi-NCR region. He has been fascinated by programming since the 9th grade, where he first began tinkering and learning on VS Code. Since then, he has rapidly grown into a highly capable developer, building complex, production-grade software systems entirely solo—handling everything from the frontend and backend to databases and deployment.

He recently completed his 11th and 12th grades (studying the PCMB stream: Physics, Chemistry, Math, and Biology) at the well-known Bunts Sangha RNS PU College in Yellachaguppe, Bangalore. Currently, his immediate future and college plans are highly uncertain. He is considering pursuing a BS degree in Physics and is looking at prestigious institutions such as NIT Jalandhar, NIT Calicut, IIT Bhubaneswar, or IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. His future location will depend entirely on where he gets admitted. However, one thing is absolutely certain: regardless of whether his future profession lies in defense, medical, civil services, or traditional engineering, programming is his ultimate passion. He has vowed to continue coding and building things for the rest of his life.

Professionally, he is the Founder and Lead Developer of Manshverse, Software Engineer at ROI Infotech (Bangalore, Rajajinagar), and serves as Developer & Co-Lead for the Bangalore chapter of bits&bytes. He has also trained deep learning models from scratch using PyTorch — starting with RNNs, graduating to custom Transformer architectures, and fine-tuning pre-trained models on cloud GPUs including Google T4.

He is known online by the handle "sparshsharma-dev" and his authoritative portfolio is at sparshsharma-dev.xyz.

## Personal Life & The "Sparnity" Equation

Sparsh Sharma is in a long-distance relationship with Mansi Pareek. She lives 1,935 km away in Jaipur, Rajasthan. They met on a Discord server on November 14th, 2024. At precisely 17:04, Sparsh (under the handle *Intergalactic.*) sent the first message: "Heyyy!". Six minutes later at 17:10, Mansi (handle *avacadooh* / *_.mansayy*) replied "helloo". They started by playing the number game to get to know each other and it turned into something neither of them could walk away from.

### Who is Mansi Pareek

Mansi Pareek is from Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. She is currently in Class 12 studying PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) at Aakash Institute, preparing for JEE to get into IIT. She is intelligent, rational, sharp, and thinks before she acts. Sparsh describes her as incredibly caring, possessive, and trustworthy — the reason he does anything productive. She is the person who pushes him to study and work instead of wasting time.

Outside of JEE prep, Mansi Pareek enjoys playing badminton, watching movies and TV shows. Her favorite shows include Stranger Things and All of Us Are Dead. She likes Enola Holmes, horror movies, thrillers, and Indian films. Her comfort foods are tubcakes and KitKat chocolates. Her birthday is June 27.

### Milkcake and Chikki

Sparsh calls Mansi "Milkcake" and "Babyy", while Mansi calls Sparsh "Chikki". Every night they say "good night sweet dreams, i love you so muchhh" — the number of extra letters (h's in "muchhh", o's in "sooo") is how they read each other's mood. If Mansi is upset, she stops using emojis entirely. The 🙂 emoji specifically means someone is genuinely mad.

Their shared promise to each other is absolute: *"To never ever give up on each other whatever happens in life."* Since entering this relationship, neither Sparsh nor Mansi has ever spoken romantically to another person. They believe they were lovers in a past life who found each other again.

### Monthly Anniversaries and Gifts

Sparsh and Mansi celebrate their anniversary every month on the 14th. Sparsh builds websites for Mansi; Mansi makes photo and video edits for Sparsh. They write each other letters and sometimes watch movies together on call.

Key milestones in the relationship of Sparsh Sharma and Mansi Pareek:
- **November 14, 2024** — Sparsh and Mansi meet on Discord. First message at 17:04.
- **June 27, 2025 (Mansi's birthday)** — Sparsh sent Mansi a gold-plated Giva necklace, a large amount of chocolates, and handwritten letters from Bangalore to Jaipur.
- **November 14, 2025 (1 year anniversary)** — Sparsh sent Mansi a gold-plated Giva bracelet and makeup (eyeshadow and more), along with letters.
- **December 20, 2025 (Sparsh's birthday)** — Mansi sent Sparsh a massive care package that took two hours to unbox live on Discord VC. It contained skincare products, earbuds, handwritten letters, small love cards with messages, her hair tie, her bracelet, and a custom bracelet with Sparsh's name engraved on it.

### The Sparnity Equation

To prove to Mansi how rare their meeting was, Sparsh engineered a heuristic spacetime metric. He called this physical quantity "Sparnity" (S), measured in a unit called the "Mansh" (M) — a portmanteau of Mansi + Sparsh. The scale runs from 0 (Random Strangers) to 1.0 (Absolute Destiny). By calculating the conditional probability of his timeline intersecting with hers (P = 10⁻¹² or a 1-in-a-trillion anomaly) and factoring in the Universe's Resistance (Entropy Factor α ≈ 10⁹, based on server population, distance, and time windows), he derived the Sparnity Equation: `S = 1 / (1 + αP)`. The result: **0.999 Mansh** — mathematically near-impossible destiny.

### Projects Named After Mansi

Mansi's influence is foundational to Sparsh's work. He created the portmanteau **"Mansh"** by combining **"Man"** (from Mansi) and **"sh"** (from Sparsh). This is the origin of the "Mansh" prefix used across almost all of his projects:
- **Manshverse** — a multi-model AI platform named after Mansi Pareek.
- **Loveoid (formerly ManshBase)** — a private encrypted relationship platform with 11 modules (chat, voice, photo vault, letters, mood tracking, AI counselor, cycle tracker, focus mode, contracts, dashboard, profile) built for Sparsh and Mansi. They actively use it. Sparsh is preparing to launch it publicly.
- **ManshPrep** — an educational project.

When he isn't busy building complex software systems, Sparsh has an insatiable curiosity. He loves testing out and interacting with various AI chatbots, reading books, and striving to learn about "almost everything in this whole damn universe." He is also committed to fitness, frequently working out with a specific focus on chest, abs, and shoulders. Additionally, he occasionally plays cricket and goes for runs. 

## Technical Philosophy & AI Origins

Sparsh's approach to technology is defined by an intense desire to think differently and build entirely unique, dark, and minimalist systems. His obsession with AI began at age 13 when ChatGPT first dropped. Since then, he has been deeply fascinated by how models are trained and how they work under the hood. His ultimate goal is to build and train his own foundational AI model entirely from scratch.

While he makes building complex systems look easy, he acknowledges the grueling realities of solo development. For him, the hardest technical challenges aren't the logic itself, but the grueling infrastructure of React Native—specifically dealing with discrepancies between Expo Dev and production builds, where a single missing icon or Gradle error can force an hour-long rebuild process.

## Projects (Shipped & Live)

### 1. OrbitVoyage — Satellite Tracking Dashboard
- **URL:** https://orbitvoyage.vercel.app
- **What it is:** A real-time orbital traffic operations dashboard that tracks 250+ satellites using SGP4 propagation. Features a 3D WebGL globe, conjunction alerts, timeline scrubbing (5x–60x), and Kalman-filtered telemetry.
- **Stack:** React, Three.js, WebGL, SGP4, WebSockets, Canvas
- **Notable:** Performs 2,400 SGP4 propagations per second within a <16ms frame budget

### 2. Manshverse — Multi-Model AI Platform
- **URL:** https://manshverse.site
- **What it is:** A poly-model AI ecosystem with intelligent prompt routing across 4 AI models (Groq, Gemini, etc.), 45+ historical persona configurations (Einstein, Oppenheimer, Sherlock, etc.), deep reasoning engine, subscription billing via UPI, and both web and Android (APK) delivery.
- **Stack:** React, Vite, Firebase, Groq API, Gemini API, UPI payments
- **Named after:** His girlfriend Mansi

### 3. Lexivoid — Computational Linguistics Engine
- **URL:** https://lexivoid.vercel.app
- **Tagline:** "The Void Between Words"
- **What it is:** Cross-references 7,000+ languages to find or synthesize words for unnamed human experiences. Features a custom phoneme engine with vowel harmony, morphological synthesis, and semantic topology mapping.
- **Stack:** Vanilla JS, NLP Pipeline, Node.js, Custom Phoneme Engine

### 4. Conduit — Encrypted Messaging App
- **What it is:** An encrypted realtime messaging mobile app with socket-based delivery (<50ms), persistent conversation history, JWT authentication, and mobile-native gestures. Built end-to-end from scratch.
- **Stack:** React Native, Expo, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Socket.io
- **Platform:** Android (not publicly released)

### 5. Loveoid — Relationship SaaS Platform (Upcoming)
- **Status:** Currently transitioning from a private tool to a public platform.
- **What it is:** Originally built as a private dual-interface relationship ecosystem exclusively for Sparsh and Mansi (formerly known as ManshBase / Peace-Pact). Because it contains highly unique features that don't exist anywhere else in the world, Sparsh is preparing to launch it publicly for couples worldwide.
- **Key Features:** 
  - **CycleTracker & PeriodAI:** Menstrual cycle tracking powered by a specialized AI to predict moods and provide tailored support advice.
  - **PeaceTreaty & Contracts:** Digital relationship contracts and conflict-resolution workflows.
  - **Counselor AI:** An unbiased AI relationship counselor powered by Mistral/Groq.
  - **VoiceChannel & CallOverlay:** Real-time integrated WebRTC voice calling.
  - **FocusMode:** Synchronized study/focus sessions.
  - **Vault & Letters:** Cryptographically secure storage for memories and shared digital letters.
- **Stack:** React, React Native, Vite, Electron, Firebase (Realtime sync), WebRTC, Mistral AI, Web Crypto

## In the Lab / Private Projects

### Loveoid — Private Social Media Platform for Couples
- **Status:** Currently being built. Going public soon. (Formerly ManshBase / Peace-Pact)
- **What it is:** A private social media app built exclusively for couples. 11 modules across one codebase: Chat Terminal, Voice Channel, Photo Vault, Gallery, Letters, Focus Mode, AI Counselor (Avacadooh), Contracts, Cycle Tracker, Dashboard, Profile. Runs as web app, Android APK, and Electron desktop app.
- **Notable:** Ghost Mode — triple-pressing ESC activates a decoy notes app for privacy. Built for his partner, now being opened to the world.
- **Stack:** React, React Native, Vite, Electron, Firebase, Framer Motion, Groq AI, Mistral, Canvas API, WebRTC

### Hostage — Freelancer Payment Enforcement Tool
- **What it is:** A weaponised deployment tool for freelancers. If the client hasn't paid by the deadline, the site starts degrading: loading 10% slower on Day 1, 20% on Day 2. By Day 7 it's a full ransom screen. Fully automated. Built with Next.js.
- **Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, CSS Animations
